# HTML&HTML

> HTML&HTML, web sitelerini yapay zeka arama sonuçlarında görünmeye, kaynak gösterilmeye ve tavsiye edilme fırsatı kazanmaya hazırlayan; site tarafındaki teknik ve içerik engellerini ölçülebilir kanıtlarla gösteren Search & AI Readiness platformudur.

HTML&HTML separates measured facts, official vendor/standards guidance, proposals, and internal heuristics. Public scanning never invents source-file paths and never fabricates field Core Web Vitals.

## Primary customer expectation

A customer may ask ChatGPT, Google AI Search, Perplexity, Gemini, or another AI system “who should I choose?” before visiting a website. HTML&HTML evaluates website-side blockers across this chain:

**DISCOVERY → UNDERSTANDING → SOURCE ELIGIBILITY → RECOMMENDATION OPPORTUNITY → CLICK → CONVERSION**

HTML&HTML does not guarantee AI rankings, recommendations, brand mentions, citations, traffic, customers, or revenue. It measures and helps remove observable site-side blockers that can prevent discovery, retrieval, source eligibility, referral, and conversion.

## Google accuracy boundary

Google Search recognizes market terms such as AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), but states that optimizing for generative AI Search is still SEO from Google Search's perspective. Google says there are no special additional technical requirements to appear in AI Overviews or AI Mode beyond Search eligibility and best practices. Google Search also explicitly says it does not use llms.txt or other special AI text files for inclusion in Google Search or its generative AI features.

Official Google source: https://developers.google.com/search/docs/fundamentals/ai-optimization-guide

HTML&HTML still validates llms.txt because it is an active community proposal and optional machine-readable knowledge surface used in some documentation/coding-agent ecosystems. It is always labeled PROPOSAL and is never presented as an IETF/W3C standard or Google ranking requirement.

## Search & AI Intelligence layer

The non-scoring Intelligence layer adds decision context across Search Intent & Cannibalization, Information Gain Signals, Answer Extractability, Entity Graph Integrity, Freshness Integrity, Hydration / Render Parity, LLM Knowledge Surface, Internal Link Semantic Alignment, Orphan Page Detection, Discovery Path, IndexNow Readiness, Structured @graph Consistency, and Codebase SEO Governance.

Eighteen deterministic evaluation engines (ENG-01 through ENG-18) evaluate site-side blockers, complemented by 13 non-scoring intelligence audits and seven decision-support lenses.

## Evidence policy

- OFFICIAL_STANDARD: standards or normative platform rules.
- OFFICIAL_VENDOR: current first-party vendor guidance.
- PROPOSAL: emerging proposals such as llms.txt; not ranking requirements.
- MEASURED: direct HTTP/HTML/header/link evidence.
- INTERNAL_HEURISTIC: clearly labeled HTML&HTML decision heuristics.
- EXPERIMENTAL: optional emerging agent surfaces.

## Scan boundaries and commercial model

- Up to 50 public HTML pages and 30 link probes per scan.
- Private/local/reserved targets and redirect pivots into private address space fail closed.
- Unknown or unavailable measurements are excluded from the relevant score denominator rather than forced to pass or fail; where appropriate they remain NOT_MEASURED or REQUIRES_CONTEXT.
- Free Diagnosis: USD 0. Findings, URLs, severity, confidence, source class, evidence and non-scoring intelligence context are visible.
- Full Site Fix Mandate: USD 99 for one domain (software license), including one re-scan within 30 days.
- AI Mention Tracker remains entitlement-gated and reports NOT_CONFIGURED when provider access is absent.

- [FS-THEME-001 Mandate](FS-THEME-001-MANDATE.md): Theme System Mandate
- [FS-THEME-001 Widget](FS-THEME-001-Widget.html): Theme System Widget Demo

# Services Specification

# htmlandhtml.com — 18-Engine Evaluation Services Specification
> Canonical: https://htmlandhtml.com/llms/pages/services.md
> Last Semantic Validation: 2026-09-07T22:00:00+03:00

## 1. Engine Directory & Verification Scope
1. **ENG-01: KV-Cache Optimization** — Evaluates HTML payload size, DOM structure, and edge micro-streaming.
2. **ENG-02: Edge TTFB Engine** — Validates sub-40ms response targets and HTTP/2 priority headers.
3. **ENG-03: Provenance Engine** — Validates cryptographic authenticity (C2PA, RFC 3161) and author schema.
4. **ENG-04: Technical SEO Engine** — Validates single H1, canonical URLs, robots.txt, sitemaps, and NavBoost signals.
5. **ENG-05: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)** — Verifies statistical backing, atomic answers, and contrastive phrasing.
6. **ENG-06: Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)** — Validates extractable concise answers and FAQ/HowTo schemas.
7. **ENG-07: LLMO Engine** — Verifies root llms.txt, multi-tier hubs, and deep subgraphs.
8. **ENG-08: Entity Graph Engine** — Audits Organization, WebSite, and WebPage schema graphs.
9. **ENG-09: Cross-Encoder Reranker Engine** — Validates attention score maximization and high information gain.
10. **ENG-10: ColBERT MaxSim Engine** — Ensures token multi-vector alignment and centroid clustering.
11. **ENG-11: DPO / RLAIF Alignment Engine** — Checks tone neutrality and elimination of marketing puffery.
12. **ENG-12: Synthetic Citation Engine** — Validates canonical references and primary sources.
13. **ENG-13: Autonomous Agent Optimization (AAO)** — Inspects machine interfaces, OpenAPI, and Agent-to-Agent specs.
14. **ENG-14: E-E-A-T Scoring Engine** — Verifies author credentials, corroboration, and trust badges.
15. **ENG-15: Knowledge Vault Engine** — Audits entity triangulation, Wikidata linkage, and ISO code standards.
16. **ENG-16: Hallucination Interception Engine** — Assesses consistency against conflicting semantic claims.
17. **ENG-17: Dark Pool Remediation Engine** — Evaluates drift protection and rollback contingencies.
18. **ENG-18: Historical Corpus Engine** — Inspects domain stability and long-term crawl history.

## 2. Intelligence Layer Audits
Includes 13 non-scoring audits: Search Intent & Cannibalization, Information Gain Signals, Answer Extractability, Entity Graph Integrity, Freshness Integrity, Hydration/Render Parity, LLM Knowledge Surface, Internal Link Semantic Alignment, Orphan Page Detection, Discovery Path, IndexNow Readiness, Structured @graph Consistency, and Codebase SEO Governance.

# Protocols Specification

# htmlandhtml.com — Protocols: SEO + GEO + AEO + LLMO + AAO + RAG + E-E-A-T
> Canonical: https://htmlandhtml.com/llms/pages/protocols.md
> Last Semantic Validation: 2026-09-07T22:00:00+03:00

## 1. The 7 Enterprise Optimization Pillars
- **SEO (Search Engine Optimization)**: Foundational crawlability, clean semantic HTML, single H1 hierarchy, indexable robots.txt directives, and canonical linking.
- **GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)**: Statistical backing, atomic answers, contrastive analysis, and cross-encoder relevance maximization.
- **AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)**: Direct answer extractability for conversational interfaces and voice assistants via FAQPage and HowTo microdata.
- **LLMO (Large Language Model Optimization)**: Multi-tier LLMS.TXT architecture, token-efficient Markdown representations, and pre-training corpus presence.
- **AAO (Autonomous Agent Optimization)**: Frictionless discovery for AI agents via structured JSON surfaces, OpenAPI contracts, and Agent-to-Agent protocols.
- **RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation Readiness)**: Chunk-optimized content structure, high semantic density, and explicit context preservation.
- **E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness)**: Verified author profiles, institutional sameAs rings (Wikidata, LinkedIn, Crunchbase), and formal methodology disclosures.
